name: aero-webscraper
description: Permission-gated reference collection and provenance-preserving library workflows with a local Python MCP backend.

interface.longDescription: One coordinator and seven specialist/library skills for approved reference collection, immutable storage, source-bound retrieval and exports. Includes a tested local Python stdio backend. A compatible local host and operator source permissions are required; account installation does not deploy a cloud scraper or connect ChatGPT web/mobile to local files.
interface.defaultPrompt: Plan a bounded documentation collection for a device or software project, using AERO-Library and reporting actual results and unresolved gaps.
